description: Reassemble the ceramic table through visible tile transfers. Empty the rack, conserve every tile identity, leave every table set as a legal run or group, and borrow from an existing table set rather than only appending rack tiles.

metadata.notes: Source-grounded tile runs/groups puzzle. The current baseline is L4/full/live: three reassembly modules and one untouched display run.

name: Borrowed Tiles
natural_language: Empty the rack by borrowing from the table, then commit a table made only of valid runs and groups.
